title: (fix) O3-5993: Reports app shows literal {parameters} instead of the missing parameter names
body:

## Summary
<!-- Please describe what problems your PR addresses. -->
The problem is that i18next interpolates placeholders with double braces ({{...}}), but the message used single braces ({parameters}), so the interpolation was never applied. This PR replaces {parameters} with {{parameters}} in the source string and all translation files, so the snackbar now lists the actual missing parameter labels e.g. "Please provide the following parameters: Start Date, Location". It also adds tests covering the missing-parameter snackbar behavior.
